stem.en: A graph of a sound wave in air shows crests 2.5 cm apart. Sound travels at 345 m/s. What is the frequency of the sound, in Hz?

explanation.en: First change the wavelength to metres: 2.5 cm = 0.025 m. ν = v ÷ λ = 345 ÷ 0.025 = 13800 Hz.

hints.en: Crest to crest is one wavelength. Change it to metres first.
